svg.title: Type localities and molecular sampling sites for the Geomys breviceps complex
svg.desc: County map of Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, and Louisiana with seven type localities and thirty-nine molecular samples from Bradley and colleagues 2023 and Halsey and colleagues 2025.
